# Google Noto Animated Emoji: credit and licence

The animated emoji in `engine/public/stickers/emoji/animated/` are Google's Noto Animated Emoji (https://googlefonts.github.io/noto-emoji-animation/).
They are licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (CC BY 4.0):
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ (legal code: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode).

Credit line: "Animated Noto Emoji by Google, licensed under CC BY 4.0."

The files are used unmodified (only their position, size and start time are chosen by the studio's scenes). Source urls and file sizes are listed in
`third-party/emoji/README.md`. This notice is kept here and in `NOTICE.md`; it is not shown on videos or on the studio screen.
